column8: Google Brotli 1.0.x; fix commit 50a9b70a. Affected range 1.0.3-1.2.0 (GHSA-9v8h-qqgm-4m35).
Google Brotli 1.1.x; fix commit da980636.
Google Brotli 1.2.x; fix commit b418fa81 (same change as 0ed4268a on main).

Pre-1.0 Brotli: outside the advisory's stated range (1.0.3-1.2.0), and the advisory does not say whether it is affected. No fix for this line; fixed names the oldest fixed release to move to (the advisory names 1.0.10, 1.1.1 and 1.2.1).
The fix 1.2.0-4.1 is in unstable (Debian bug 1151690), but forky still had 1.2.0-4 on 2026-11-02 (https://sources.debian.org/api/src/brotli/). Treated as unfixed until it migrates.
1.2.0-4.1 is in the archive (https://sources.debian.org/api/src/brotli/ lists it for sid, 2026-11-02); the tracker shows sid fixed (Debian bug 1151690).

Ubuntu 22.04. USN-8956-1 (2026-10-26) fixes brotli, libbrotli1 and python3-brotli; the CVE page (https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-111497) says "Fixed in 1.0.9-2ubuntu0.1". Until 2026-10-26 the status was "Needs evaluation" (this version was a candidate in the ubuntu-security-proposed PPA).

Ubuntu 24.04. USN-8956-1 (2026-10-26) fixes brotli, libbrotli1 and python3-brotli; the CVE page (https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-111497) says "Fixed in 1.1.0-2ubuntu0.1". Until 2026-10-26 the status was "Needs evaluation" (this version was a candidate in the ubuntu-security-proposed PPA).

Ubuntu 26.04. USN-8956-1 (2026-10-26) fixes brotli, libbrotli1 and python3-brotli; the CVE page (https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-111497) says "Fixed in 1.2.0-3ubuntu0.1". Until 2026-10-26 the status was "Needs evaluation" (this version was a candidate in the ubuntu-security-proposed PPA).

Ubuntu 20.04. USN-8956-2 (2026-10-27): the fix is available with Ubuntu Pro only; the CVE page (https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-111497) says "Fixed in 1.0.7-6ubuntu0.1+esm1".
Ubuntu 18.04. USN-8956-2 (2026-10-27): the fix is available with Ubuntu Pro only; the CVE page (https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-111497) says "Fixed in 1.0.3-1ubuntu1.3+esm1".

Ubuntu 16.04. USN-8956-2 (2026-10-27): the fix is available with Ubuntu Pro (Legacy Support add-on) only; the CVE page (https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-111497) says "Fixed in 1.0.3-1ubuntu1~16.04.2+esm1".

Ubuntu 22.04 .NET 6. The CVE page says "deferred" ("until information is available to determine if it is impacted"); no fix released. .NET 6 bundles Brotli 1.0.9 (dotnet/runtime v6.0.36, src/libraries/Native/AnyOS/brotli-version.txt), in the affected range. dotnet8 is fixed on this release.

Derived: Ubuntu 22.04 .NET 7. The CVE page says "ignored" (".NET 7 is end of life upstream"). .NET 7 bundles Brotli 1.0.9 (dotnet/runtime v7.0.20, src/native/external/brotli-version.txt), in the affected range, and gets no fix.

End-of-life line. Brotli was bundled from 10.16/11.7; earlier builds may not contain it. Update to 22/24/26 either way.
Derived: the advisory says end-of-life versions are always affected, and no fixed release exists for this line (20 and earlier, 21, 23, 25). Move to 22/24/26.
Affected >= 1.0.21, < 1.4.4; executables built with "bun build --compile" stay affected until rebuilt. Source analysis agrees: bun-v1.4.4 pins Brotli db24a98a (v1.2.1).

Microsoft .NET 8 runtime and NativeAOT packages (GHSA-p3jp-9v83-76w9, 2026-10-25). dotnet/runtime v8.0.33 moved src/native/external/brotli from 1.0.9 to 1.0.10. Its library carries no decoder error names, so the version is read from its build stamp (docs/design.md 10.27).
Microsoft .NET 9 (GHSA-p3jp-9v83-76w9). dotnet/runtime v9.0.22 moved Brotli from 1.1.0 to 1.1.1.

Microsoft .NET 10 (GHSA-p3jp-9v83-76w9). Built from dotnet/dotnet (the VMR): v10.0.14 moved src/runtime/src/native/external/brotli from 1.1.0 to 1.1.1 (the dotnet/runtime tags v10.0.13 and v10.0.14 are one commit and do not show it).

Microsoft .NET 11 previews: affected from 11.0.0-preview.1.26104.118, fixed in 11.0.0-rc.3.26522.148 (the affected column takes no pre-release, so it is not filled). VMR v11.0.0-rc.3.26522.148 has Brotli 1.1.1.
